# Bush: three faceted lumps of cyan foliage. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Leaf --base-color 0.2863 0.9059 0.9255 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name B0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.55 --location 0 0 0.42
add mesh ico-sphere --name B1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.42 --location 0.5 0.15 0.32
add mesh ico-sphere --name B2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.38 --location -0.45 0.1 0.3
select B0 B1 B2
active B0
join
rename B0 Bush
material assign Leaf
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 2
mode object
shade flat
export bush.glb
